body:
S416-07 was mis-filed under NOCK's own backlog (shared a founder quote with the imagemagick-replacement idea, S416-05) — 'PE' is DUNG, not internal/nock. Real scoping pass added to DUNG/NORTHSTAR.md: the real hook (editor/events.prn subscribe, plugin.prn register-command), the founder's 'written in PARENA' constraint (a macro is a real .prn file), and the one open design question (compile-on-demand via burrow vs. an interpreted Vec<Command> dispatcher, since a macro can't wait on a recompile+relink cycle). Gated behind DUNG's own Phase 2+. No code — scoping only. Commits: DUNG fccef06+998f56e, IDUNA 57f0965+5fedb84.

⚓ ☃
title: Real scoping pass: PE macro recording, re-homed from NOCK to DUNG
